THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
WINTER
046
STUDY 070
Cream Wool Coat & Fur Hat in Snow
Rights check
Source: 24410.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with soft, wavy light brown
hair stands in a snowy garden. She wears a long,
fit-and-flare cream wool coat with a brown fur collar and
matching brown fur cuffs, and a brown fur pillbox hat.
Cream knit gloves rest together at her waist. Her
expression is calm and composed. Overcast winter
light and a bare tree in the background. Palette of
cream, chocolate brown, and snow white. Classic and
vintage, in the style of a mid-century winter fashion
plate.
Classic, vintage, wintry
WORKING NOTES
- The brown fur collar and cuffs against the cream coat are
the defining contrast.
- Use 'full-length' to show the coat's flared hem.
